chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.tsx ThreadCard is the heart of the spec: 3-line anatomy (slug/pin + status-or-age that cross-fades to snooze/settle/overflow, title, branch+PR+forecast+provider), stretch-select overlay, statusLabelFor derived from statusDotFor. Kanban still imports ThreadCard — extra props are optional so App.tsx stays untouched.
risks: Hover actions live in a sibling of cardSelect with pointer-events re-enabled. A regression that nests them inside the select button would fail a11y and click targeting.
statusLabelFor adds unread Done and short labels (Waiting/Quota/Stalled) on top of statusDotFor. If a future status is added only to the dot helper, the card will silently show relative age.
Pin moved from data-pin-btn to overflow data-pin-item. Renderer tests that still click data-pin-btn will fail until the test worker merges.

chunks.rationale: Sidebar chrome + list: brand without +, search row with data-new-thread / caret / data-create-* plus data-create-from-issue, scope dropdown (sidebar:projectScope) with gear/x, icon view nav, then buildFlatSidebar + flatVisibleThreadIds. Snoozed/Settled shelves default collapsed (sidebar:snoozedOpen / sidebar:settledOpen), archived pages 10/+25 at the Settled tail, carve-out keeps the open thread visible.
risks: Search ignores project scope (spec) but create still targets the scoped project. Easy to wire the filter onto searchHits by accident.

SubagentRows, spend meter, Settle all, Clear settled, and per-group create clusters were deleted per spec. Callers of onClearSettled/spendTodayUsd still exist on the props type; they just no longer render.
Shelf localStorage keys are new. The old coder.sidebar.settledCollapsed default-expanded state is ignored — existing users see collapsed shelves on first launch of this UI.

chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.module.css is the visual contract: 13px/11px, 400/500/600, listed tokens plus --bg-elevated/--bg for chrome, color-mix for alphas, no hex. Dead group/Later/pill classes removed.
risks: CSS modules will undefined-miss any leftover className if a later edit adds an old class back without the rule.
Status/actions cross-fade uses :has(.cardActions) and :has(:focus-visible). Very old Electron would skip the fade; current Solenta's Electron is fine.
npm run test:renderer will fail until the parallel test-worker branch merges — expected; this worker did not touch test/.
No browser verification: this is an Electron renderer, not a web app with browser tools in this worktree.
